lead.en: Follow multi-stage execution steps beside a docked, filterable step log console.
lead.zh: 左侧跟踪多阶段执行步骤，右侧联动展示对应步骤的实时日志。

rule.en: Select any stage to inspect its summary, metrics, and scoped logs; enable Auto-follow to track active or failed stages automatically.
rule.zh: 点击任意步骤即可查看摘要、指标与对应日志；开启自动跟随会自动追踪活动或异常步骤。

motion.en: Stage selection and filter chips update immediately using semantic KUI tokens with zero decorative motion.
motion.zh: 步骤切换与筛选状态直接使用语义令牌响应，无多余装饰动画。

lead.en: Explore multi-source logs with live search, severity chips, tail follow, and structured details.
lead.zh: 多源聚合日志浏览器，支持实时搜索、级别筛选、末尾跟随与结构化详情。

rule.en: Filter by source, severity level, or keyword query without mutating the underlying stream, and select any row to inspect its structured attributes.
rule.zh: 按来源、级别或关键词实时过滤，点击任意日志行即可在右侧查看完整结构化字段。

motion.en: Uses the capsule KUI Switch for tail follow and crisp hairline borders across panes.
motion.zh: 末尾跟随沿用 KUI 胶囊开关，分栏采用清晰的单像素发丝线边界。

lead.en: Inspect captured frames with protocol layer trees, redaction markers, and hex/ASCII dumps.
lead.zh: 分层协议抓包检视器，支持协议过滤、脱敏高亮与 Hex/ASCII 载荷查看。

rule.en: Filter frames by protocol or error state, then select a frame to inspect decoded protocol layers and its redacted wire hex dump.
rule.zh: 按协议类型或异常状态筛选数据帧，点击帧行即可查看分层字段与脱敏后的十六进制载荷。

motion.en: Frame selection highlights the active row and updates the layer tree and hex view in place.
motion.zh: 选中数据帧即时高亮当前行并同步更新协议层与十六进制视图。
